cloud_model.description: Cloud model for word-finding, sentences and hints.

cloud_backup_models.description: Other cloud models, asked as well when the main one is slow to start answering. Comma-separated, in the order they are asked. Empty = none.

cloud_hedge_ms.description: If a cloud request has not started answering after this long, the same request also goes to the next cloud model in turn (main, then each backup, then round again), up to four requests. The first to start answering is used. 0 = never ask again.

voice_model.description: Cloud model for the natural voice.

guess_count.description: How many word tiles to ask for (3 to 8).

device_timeout_ms.description: How long to wait for the on-device model to start answering before asking the cloud.

cloud_patience_ms.description: Actions and feelings go to the cloud first. If the cloud has not started answering after this long and the on-device model is ready, the device answers and the cloud's words are added later.

cloud_thinking.description: Cloud thinking level: MINIMAL, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, or empty for the model default.

limited_use_tokens.description: One-time App Check tokens (replay protection). Adds about half a second per cloud request.

natural_voice.description: Allow the natural cloud voice for sentences.

prompt_overrides.description: JSON of prompt-pack paths to replacement text, e.g. {"find.system": "..."}.
